scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the red flag
scenarios.hook: Lights out, Leclerc into the wall at the Parabolica on lap 2 — yellow, Safety Car, red flag, and the whole field files into the pits.

events.title: RED FLAG
events.body: Leclerc hit the wall at the Parabolica at the end of the second lap, bringing out a red flag. The field parked in the pit lane for 29 minutes before the race resumed from a standing restart.

scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the restart
scenarios.hook: The field forms up on the grid for a standing restart — lights out again at 1:20 in, then three green laps of scramble, Antonelli climbing.

provenance.note: F1's telemetry feed drops for a few seconds per car, once a lap at a fixed spot on the circuit, throughout this session. During a dropout a car's speed freezes and its position coasts ahead of reality — Colapinto's brief P1 into della Roggia at 1:52 never happened. A detection screen is planned; until it ships, the replay shows the feed as recorded.

scenarios.title: Silverstone 2024 · the rain arrives
scenarios.hook: Watch the thermal trail go cold as the shower lands and the speeds collapse.

scenarios.title: Silverstone 2024 · the last laps
scenarios.hook: Hamilton holding Verstappen off, softs against hards, with Norris in range.

scenarios.title: Monza 2024 · the pit cycle
scenarios.hook: Seven laps of stops and undercuts: the timing tower reshuffles as they go.
